$comment: Authoritative attestation reference for the production publicai-gateway CVM. Fetched at runtime by the /proof page. composeHash was read back from the CVM's RTMR3 event log on 2026-08-28 and cross-checked against the Phala control-plane API; both report ce8e7691. Image digests are the linux/amd64 children of the cosign-signed proof-v17 indexes (sub2api INDEX 73ef7182, attestor INDEX 95d947bb) built by publish-tee-images run 33147862253; the keyless signatures verify against certificate identity https://github.com/FiiLabs/sub2api/.github/workflows/publish-tee-images.yml@refs/heads/feat/two-sided-market, and the Fulcio certificates embed githubWorkflowSha = the sourceCommit below. THIS RELEASE FIXES A REFERENCE-SOURCE BUG: the /proof page used to fetch this file from the proof-solo branch while images were built from feat/two-sided-market. The two only stayed in sync because someone remembered to commit the same file twice; a reference describing a different build does not merely fail to help, it reports a healthy deployment as a TAMPERED enclave. Both the authoritative URL and the CDN mirror now point at the release branch, and a frontend test pins them to it. The release also cuts first-screen download from 1332KB to 118KB (-91%) via two changes: Vite modulePreload no longer resolves lazy-route dependencies (they were being preloaded on the homepage), and static assets are pre-compressed at build time and served as .gz by internal/web/precompressed.go. The CVM was resized back to 1 vCPU / 2GB in the same window: it had been scaled to 4/8 on a WRONG diagnosis (TLS handshake CPU), which measurement disproved — handshake time did not improve at 4 cores. The real cause was download volume. osImageHash, appId and instanceId are unchanged; the deploy passed --no-dev-os explicitly, because phala deploy silently switches to a dev OS image when it detects a local SSH key and a dev OS would void the attestation.
